failed_edge: The proof infers the prime-divisor noncongruences using an incorrect modulus and then an order that contradicts its assumption.
reason: Modulo $2$, $-1\equiv1$, so the first asserted noncongruence is false; it must be modulo $p$. Also, the hypothesis is $\operatorname{ord}_p(-a)=(p-1)/2$, not $p-1$. Although the conclusion is repairable—because for each odd $p_i\mid p-1$, $(p-1)/2\nmid(p-1)/p_i$—the written prime-divisor criterion is not justified.
